anchor_source: Square-root impact law (Grinold & Kahn; Toth et al., 2011)
anchor_text: Empirical market impact follows the square-root law, scaling with volatility times the square root of order size over daily volume, with the coefficient Y typically estimated between 0.5 and 1.

anchor_text: The stochastic oscillator uses a 14-period %K with a 3-period %D, with readings below 20 considered oversold.

anchor_source: Harris & Gurel, Journal of Finance, 1986 (index inclusion effects)
